professionalSummary: Data Scientist with extensive experience designing, executing, and reporting A/B tests on signup and trial journeys, ensuring rigorous randomisation, power calculations, and metric governance.

evidence.text: Planned 23 A/B tests on the signup and trial journeys at Ledgerline, writing each plan with a primary metric, a power calculation and a fixed test window before launch.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of planning with required elements.

evidence.text: Wrote the readout for the trial-reminder email test: trial-to-paid conversion was 6.2% in control and 7.0% in treatment over 4 to 31 March 2024, a difference of 0.8 points with a 95% interval of 0.3 to 1.3 points.
evidence.notes: Includes effect size and confidence interval.

evidence.text: Added an automated sample-ratio check to the readout notebook template that blocks publication when the observed split departs from the plan by more than the agreed threshold.
